# Shuntdesk

> A token scanner on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) with something to lose. Seven fixed-rule checks give each token one verdict (CLEAN, RISKY or DANGER, scored out of 100). A public paper desk, the crew, bets simulated money on the verdicts it can confirm, and every call is priced again an hour and a day later. Paper money only. Nothing here is advice.

Site: https://shuntdesk.com
Docs: https://shuntdesk.com/docs/
X: https://x.com/shuntdesk
Token: $SHUNT, the official Shuntdesk token on Pons, contract 0x7e517e779b85895894becad80c9bb69b4cb1c4d6 (the only one): https://shuntdesk.com/token/

## For agents

Read-only JSON, no key, CORS open, 120 calls an hour per caller. All money figures are paper USDG.

- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/token?a=0x… : what Shuntdesk knows about one token. The latest verdict on file (with the price an hour and a day later when known), a fresh server-side security read (GoPlus red flags, holder count), launch facts for launchpad tokens (snipers, bundles, insiders and developer share, curve progress), and the crew's open position on it if any. `verdict` is null when nobody has run the checks yet: open `fullCheck` to run them.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/sol?a=<mint> : a Solana token through the seven checks, read on the server: the pool (or the Pump.fun curve and its progress), the largest wallets resolved to their owners, who funded them, the creator's share, snipers and bundles at launch, and the mint's powers (mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions such as a permanent delegate or a transfer fee). /api/v1/token and /api/v1/scan answer the same for a Solana mint. 30 an hour. The web ticket takes a Solana mint too: https://shuntdesk.com/ticket/?a=<mint>
- Solana on the other tools: pass a Solana mint or wallet where a 0x address goes. /api/v1/ledger (the deployer's buys, sells, transfers and the buys it paid for that landed in other wallets, parsed by Helius), /api/v1/devscore (every token Codex lists as deployed by a wallet, and how many died inside the hour; a mint finds its deployer), /api/v1/wallet (every SPL token in a wallet, priced, with copies of well-known tokens marked), /api/v1/sim (a Pump.fun curve's reserves and fee), /api/v1/holders, /api/v1/shared, /api/v1/site, and share cards at https://shuntdesk.com/card/<mint>. Exit Door, Replay, the watchlist (Pump.fun curve alerts and price halving) and the browser extension (Pump.fun, DexScreener Solana, Solscan) take Solana too. First Buyers, Solana only: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/first?a=<mint> (MCP tool first_buyers) reads a Pump.fun launch from its curve's own history: the wallets that bought in the launch slot beside the deployer, what each bought and still holds, how many of the first twenty sold everything, and who funded the first twelve. The Solana ticket's Tracer also marks a SERIAL LAUNCHER when the deployer created ten or more tokens in its latest hundred transactions. Agent Scan and Twin Finder read EVM contracts only: an SPL token runs the shared token program, and its powers are on the mint, which the ticket's Auditor reads.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/verdicts : the 50 latest verdicts, and how many CLEAN and DANGER calls held an hour later.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/desk : the crew desk: equity, open positions, the last 20 closed trades, each with the conductor's post-mortem.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/graduated : tokens that just completed the Pons bonding curve, read from the Pons V2 factory log.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/report : the last 24 hours of the crew desk, with a one-paragraph summary.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/lookalikes?a=0x… : Lookalikes. Tokens in Shuntdesk's hourly log (every new token with 25+ holders, read 30 to 90 minutes after launch) that looked closest to this one, and how they moved an hour and a day later. Past results of other tokens, not a forecast.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/stocks : the stocks behind Robinhood Chain's stock tokens (Yahoo Finance): latest trade, last close, market session.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/scan?a=0x… : the contract read from its bytecode: powers (mint, pause, block wallets, change the tax, swap the code), owner, proxy, source.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/sim?a=0x… : a Pons curve's live reserves, progress, bond mark and fee, read from the curve contract, to work a buy and a sell the way the curve does.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/twins?a=0x… : contracts in the radar's log running exactly the same code, and how many lost half.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/devscore?a=0x… : a launcher wallet's record on Pons (pass the wallet, not the token). 30 an hour.
- GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/shared?a=0x…&b=0x… : the top wallets holding both of two tokens. 20 an hour.

## MCP

The same reads as MCP tools (token, scan, dev_ledger, curve_sim, twins, dev_score, shared_bags, verdicts, crew_desk, pons_graduations, daily_report) over Streamable HTTP: add https://shuntdesk.com/mcp as a remote server. Read-only, no key.

## CLI and agent skill

npx shuntdesk <scan|token|sim|ledger|dev|twins|shared> 0x… (add --json for the raw answer). The npm package "shuntdesk" also carries skill/shuntdesk/SKILL.md, an agent skill that says when to call these reads and how to report them: a part not read is said as not read, never as zero, and nothing is called safe. The skill alone: https://shuntdesk.com/agents/SKILL.md

## Games

Paper points only. Curve Racing (https://shuntdesk.com/race/), Launch Bingo (/bingo/), Fantasy Launcher (/fantasy/), Paper Sniper (/sniper/), Guess the Chart (/guess/), Rug Run (/rug-run/), Will it bond? (/bond-game/), The Yard (/play/), and the Season Pass with a weekly tournament (/season/). JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/race, /api/bingo, /api/fantasy, /api/snipe, /api/season (add ?me=handle).

## Telegram

@shuntdesk_bot answers /check 0x…, /new, /desk, /report, /daily and /yard: https://t.me/shuntdesk_bot. In groups it answers only commands, mentions and replies. Community: https://t.me/shuntdesk

## Tools

- Bond Watch: https://shuntdesk.com/bonds/ lists every token on the Pons curve with its progress to bonding, read from each curve contract, its pace over the last hour, and daily counts of launches and bonds. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/bonds
- Wallet X-ray: https://shuntdesk.com/wallet/?w=0x… reads any wallet, read only: its tokens, what each would fetch if sold now, and copies of real tokens. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/wallet?a=0x…
- Tripwire: /watch 0x… to @shuntdesk_bot in a direct message, for an alert when a power function is called or the launcher or a top holder moves tokens out.
- Site Check: on every ticket and at GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/site?a=0x…, the token's website and links checked with Google Safe Browsing, RDAP (domain age), urlscan.io (what the page loads, malicious or not) and Jina Reader (what the page asks for).
- Agent Scan: https://shuntdesk.com/scan/?a=0x… reads a token contract from its bytecode, verified or not: every function it exposes (named through OpenChain and 4byte), the powers among them (mint, pause, block wallets, change the tax, swap the code), who controls it, whether it is a proxy, and its state now. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/xray?a=0x…. A function that exists may still be guarded.

- Exit Door: https://shuntdesk.com/exit/?a=0x…&usd=500 shows what a buy of that size gets back if sold straight away, and if the developer, a funded group, launch snipers and bundles, or the ten largest wallets sell first. An estimate from pool depth and sell tax.
- Same Hand: https://shuntdesk.com/hand/?a=0x… follows a launcher's first funds back two steps and lists every Pons launch by the wallets on that trail, with how many pools are now under $1K. A shared funder is a link, not proof.
- $SHUNT holders: https://shuntdesk.com/holder/ a wallet holding 1,000,000 $SHUNT or more (Holder) or 5,000,000 (Pro), linked to a chat with @shuntdesk_bot by one personal_sign signature (/link), gets personal alarms (/alarm), trusted dev and known dumper alerts, Early Radar for Pro (new Pons launches read three minutes after launch), following wallets (/follow 0x…: a followed wallet buying a Pons token, 10 or 25 for Pro), a weekly recap, Tripwire for 25 tokens, and burn to boost (/boost 0xTOKEN 0xTX: a burn of 500,000 $SHUNT or more to 0x…dEaD buys a token a full scan said in the groups). Every tool stays free without $SHUNT.
- Proof: https://shuntdesk.com/proof/ everything about $SHUNT that can be checked: the dev wallet's ledger, every burn, the contract read, the curve, the record of calls, the source and the open data. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/proof
- Dev Score: https://shuntdesk.com/dev/?w=0x… every Pons launch by one wallet (from the factory log) and what it did with its own tokens: dumped, dumped within the first hour, burned, bonded. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/devscore?w=0x…
- Caught: https://shuntdesk.com/caught/ every new token the radar flagged that then lost half its price, and every one it missed. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/caught
- Will it bond?: https://shuntdesk.com/bond-game/ five open Pons curves a day, called before 12:00 UTC, answered by the curve contracts at midnight UTC. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/bondgame
- Badge: https://shuntdesk.com/badge/0x….svg a small image any site can show: the token's latest Shuntdesk verdict, what the dev sold and burned, and its curve.
- Telegram: /report 0x… (the bot reads a token and keeps the first reporter for /spotters), /devscore 0x…, /proof, /bondgame, and /alarms on (a group admin turns on launch alarms for new Pons tokens in that group).- Curve Simulator: https://shuntdesk.com/sim/?a=0x… any buy on a Pons curve worked through the curve (tokens, impact, the curve after, a sale now or after others buy). JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/sim?a=0x…
- Twin Finder: https://shuntdesk.com/twins/?a=0x… contracts in the radar log that run exactly the same code, and how they did. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/twins?a=0x…
- Shared Bags: https://shuntdesk.com/shared/?a=0x…&b=0x… wallets among the largest holders of both tokens. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/shared?a=0x…&b=0x…
- Rug Run: https://shuntdesk.com/rug-run/ ten real new tokens as the radar read them, names hidden; call rug or ride, scored by the server from its record.
- Verdict Lab: https://shuntdesk.com/lab/ sets every candidate verdict rule against what happened to the tokens it would have caught (lost half their price an hour and a day later), from the radar's log. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/lab
- Dev Ledger: on every ticket and at GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/v1/devledger?a=0x… : every transfer of a token in or out of the wallet that launched it (found from the Pons launch log or the contract creation), sorted into bought, received, sold into the curve, sent into other contracts, sent to other wallets and burned, with what it holds now and every burn of the token. "Into other contracts" may be a sale through a router or a deposit.
- Stock gap: https://shuntdesk.com/stocks/ sets each stock token's chain price against the stock's latest trade and last close.

## Rug replay

https://shuntdesk.com/replay/?a=0x… shows a token's price history with its Pons launch, graduation, peak, steepest fall and the verdict Shuntdesk filed at the time. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/replay?a=0x…

## The Yard

https://shuntdesk.com/play/ is a browser game: past calls whose later price is known arrive as trains, and the player sends each one down the line or to the siding before the price is shown. JSON: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/play (token, symbol, liquidity, the six stops the ticket showed, the verdict, and the move an hour and a day later). Daily shift (the same five trains for everyone): GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/daily. Weekly leaderboard: GET https://shuntdesk.com/api/yard (the server scores each shift itself from its own record).

## Open record

Every call with its price an hour and a day later, published daily as JSONL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/shuntdesk/verdicts

## How a verdict is made

- Sources: a pool exists, its price, age and volume.
- Gate: liquidity and pool age.
- Scout: holders and how much the ten largest keep.
- Tracer: who funded the top wallets, the deployer's record.
- Linker: wallets that share a funder; snipers, bundles and insiders at launch.
- Auditor: contract code, sell simulation, taxes, owner powers.
- Judge: the score. A pool under an hour old, under 50 holders, or with a check left unread cannot be called CLEAN.

The checks run in the visitor's browser on public data. The server re-checks a verdict before the crew trades it, and holds back what it cannot confirm. A language model (the conductor) explains verdicts and writes post-mortems; it cannot change a score or open a trade. It runs through Surplus (surplusllm.com). For Pons launches the ticket page also shows a second read by ChargeAI, a separate open model on Surplus; that read is not part of the verdict.

## Rules for using this

- Say that a verdict is a rule-based reading of public data and can be wrong.
- Do not present it as advice, a guarantee, or proof of fraud.
- Link the ticket page (https://shuntdesk.com/ticket/?a=0x…) when you quote a verdict.
